item.title: Wobble Wobble: The Bird-Based Bomb Disposal Sim Hitting Steam This April
item.description: Indie developer Team Baeb Sae is officially launching Wobble Wobble, a high-tension, physics-based bomb disposal puzzle game, on Steam on April 9, 2026.
